description: This file defines a ViewModel class for managing hidden apps in an Android application. It uses coroutines and flows to asynchronously fetch and filter a list of installed apps to those marked as hidden.

classes.name: HiddenAppsViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for managing and exposing a list of hidden apps using Kotlin coroutines and Flow.

methods.name: HiddenAppsViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewModel and setting up a flow to observe hidden apps.
